hook.en: A drone flies 3 m east, 4 m north and 12 m up. Those three numbers, its *components*, tell us everything about the flight: its length, its direction, and where its midpoint was.
hook.kn: ಡ್ರೋನ್ 3 ಮೀ ಪೂರ್ವ, 4 ಮೀ ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು 12 ಮೀ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾರುತ್ತದೆ. ಈ ಮೂರು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು, ಅದರ ಘಟಕಗಳು, ಹಾರಾಟದ ಉದ್ದ, ದಿಕ್ಕು ಮತ್ತು ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದುವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

say.en: A drone flies 3 metres east, 4 metres north and 12 metres up. Those three numbers, its components, tell us everything about the flight: its length, its direction, and where its midpoint was. In this lesson: Write the vector joining two points in components.
Find direction cosines and direction ratios.
Use the section formula in vector form.

title.en: Components and the vector joining two points

body.en: Any vector can be written $\vec a = a_1\hat i + a_2\hat j + a_3\hat k$; $a_1, a_2, a_3$ are its scalar *components*. The vector from $P(x_1, y_1, z_1)$ to $Q(x_2, y_2, z_2)$ is $(x_2 - x_1)\hat i + (y_2 - y_1)\hat j + (z_2 - z_1)\hat k$. Two vectors are collinear exactly when one is a scalar multiple of the other.
body.kn: ಯಾವ ಸದಿಶವನ್ನೂ a₁i + a₂j + a₃k ಎಂದು ಬರೆಯಬಹುದು. P ಯಿಂದ Q ಗೆ ಸದಿಶ = Q ಯ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕಗಳು ಕಳೆ P ಯದು. ಒಂದು ಸದಿಶ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ಅದಿಶ ಗುಣಕವಾದರೆ ಅವು ಸಮರೇಖೀಯ.

points.en: PQ⃗ = (position *vector* of Q) − (position vector of P)

narration.en: Every vector can be written using its three components along i, j and k. The vector from P to Q is the coordinates of Q minus the coordinates of P: always end minus start. Two vectors are collinear when one is a multiple of the other.
narration.kn: ಯಾವ ಸದಿಶವನ್ನೂ a₁i + a₂j + a₃k ಎಂದು ಬರೆಯಬಹುದು. P ಯಿಂದ Q ಗೆ ಸದಿಶ = Q ಯ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕಗಳು ಕಳೆ P ಯದು. ಒಂದು ಸದಿಶ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ಅದಿಶ ಗುಣಕವಾದರೆ ಅವು ಸಮರೇಖೀಯ.

say.en: Every vector can be written using its three components along i, j and k. The vector from P to Q is the coordinates of Q minus the coordinates of P: always end minus start. Two vectors are collinear when one is a multiple of the other. PQ⃗ = position vector of Q - position vector of P.
say.kn: ಯಾವ ಸದಿಶವನ್ನೂ a 1i plus a 2j plus a 3k ಎಂದು ಬರೆಯಬಹುದು. P ಯಿಂದ Q ಗೆ ಸದಿಶ equals Q ಯ ನಿರ್ದೇಶಾಂಕಗಳು ಕಳೆ P ಯದು. ಒಂದು ಸದಿಶ ಇನ್ನೊಂದರ ಅದಿಶ ಗುಣಕವಾದರೆ ಅವು ಸಮರೇಖೀಯ.

say.en: Collinear if and only if components proportional.

narration.en: The teacher builds the vector joining two points, the direction cosines, and the section formula with a worked example.

say.en: The vector from P to Q is the position vector of Q minus that of P. Subtract the coordinates.
A vector a i plus b j plus c k makes angles alpha, beta, gamma with the axes. Their cosines l, m, n are the direction cosines.
Section formula. A point R divides A B in the ratio m to n. Its position vector is m b plus n a, over m plus n.
Example: a = i plus 2 j minus k, b = minus i plus j plus k, ratio 2 to 1 internally: we get minus i plus 4 j plus k, all over 3.

draw.tex: \frac{2(-\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)+(\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k)}{3}=\frac{-\hat i+4\hat j+\hat k}{3}

narration.en: R divides PQ internally in the ratio m : n when R = (mQ + nP)/(m + n), and externally when R = (mQ − nP)/(m − n). Drag P and Q and change the ratio.
narration.kn: R, PQ ಯನ್ನು m : n ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ R = (mQ + nP)/(m + n); ಹೊರಗಿನಿಂದ ಆದರೆ R = (mQ − nP)/(m − n). P, Q ಎಳೆದು ಅನುಪಾತ ಬದಲಿಸಿ.

say.kn: R, PQ ಯನ್ನು m: n ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸಿದರೆ R equals mQ plus nP/m plus n; ಹೊರಗಿನಿಂದ ಆದರೆ R equals (mQ - nP)/(m - n). P, Q ಎಳೆದು ಅನುಪಾತ ಬದಲಿಸಿ.

body.en: If $\vec r = a\hat i + b\hat j + c\hat k$ makes angles $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ with the axes, its *direction cosines* are $l = \cos\alpha = \frac{a}{|\vec r|}$, $m = \frac{b}{|\vec r|}$, $n = \frac{c}{|\vec r|}$, and $l^2 + m^2 + n^2 = 1$. Any numbers proportional to $l, m, n$, such as $a, b, c$, are direction ratios.
body.kn: ಸದಿಶವು ಅಕ್ಷಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ α, β, γ ಕೋನ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳೇ ದಿಕ್ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳು; l² + m² + n² = 1. ಅವಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳು.

points.en: Direction ratios are not unique; *direction cosines* are (up to sign of the line)

narration.en: The cosines of the angles a vector makes with the three axes are its direction cosines. Divide each component by the magnitude to get them, and their squares always add up to one. The components themselves are direction ratios.
narration.kn: ಸದಿಶವು ಅಕ್ಷಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ α, β, γ ಕೋನ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳೇ ದಿಕ್ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳು; l² + m² + n² = 1. ಅವಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳು.

say.en: The cosines of the angles a vector makes with the three axes are its direction cosines. Divide each component by the magnitude to get them, and their squares always add up to one. The components themselves are direction ratios. l squared plus m squared plus n squared equals 1 always.
say.kn: ಸದಿಶವು ಅಕ್ಷಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ alpha, beta, gamma ಕೋನ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ ಅವುಗಳ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳೇ ದಿಕ್ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳು; l squared plus m squared plus n squared equals 1. ಅವಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಪಾತೀಯ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಗಳು ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳು.

say.en: Direction ratios are not unique; direction cosines are up to sign of the line.

body.en: If $A$ and $B$ have position vectors $\vec a$ and $\vec b$, the point $R$ dividing $AB$ internally in the ratio $m : n$ has position vector $\frac{m\vec b + n\vec a}{m + n}$; externally, $\frac{m\vec b - n\vec a}{m - n}$. The midpoint is $\frac{\vec a + \vec b}{2}$.
body.kn: AB ಯನ್ನು m : n ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದು (mb + na)/(m + n); ಹೊರಗಿನಿಂದ (mb − na)/(m − n). ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದು (a + b)/2.

points.en: m pairs with b⃗, n pairs with a⃗ (cross-multiply)

narration.en: The point dividing A B internally in the ratio m to n has position vector m b plus n a, over m plus n. Notice m goes with b, the far end. For external division use minus signs. The midpoint is a plus b over 2.
narration.kn: AB ಯನ್ನು m : n ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದು (mb + na)/(m + n); ಹೊರಗಿನಿಂದ (mb − na)/(m − n). ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದು (a + b)/2.

say.en: The point dividing A B internally in the ratio m to n has position vector m b plus n a, over m plus n. Notice m goes with b, the far end. For external division use minus signs. The midpoint is a plus b over 2. m pairs with b⃗, n pairs with a⃗ (cross-multiply).
say.kn: AB ಯನ್ನು m: n ಅನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಳಗಿನಿಂದ ವಿಭಾಗಿಸುವ ಬಿಂದು mb plus na/m plus n; ಹೊರಗಿನಿಂದ (mb - na)/(m - n). ಮಧ್ಯಬಿಂದು a plus b/2.

problem.en: A and B have position vectors a⃗ = î + 2ĵ − k̂ and b⃗ = −î + ĵ + k̂. Find the position vector of the point dividing AB (i) internally and (ii) externally in the ratio 2 : 1.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A and B have position vectors a⃗ = î + 2ĵ − k̂ and b⃗ = −î + ĵ + k̂. Find the position vector of the point dividing AB (i) internally and (ii) externally in the ratio 2 : 1.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A and B have position vectors a⃗ = î plus 2ĵ - k̂ and b⃗ = -î plus ĵ plus k̂. Find the position vector of the point dividing AB i internally and ii externally in the ratio 2: 1.
Internal: (2b⃗ plus a⃗)/3 equals (minus 2î plus 2ĵ plus 2k̂ plus î plus 2ĵ - k̂)/3 equals (-î plus 4ĵ plus k̂)/3.
External: (2b⃗ - a⃗)/2 minus 1 equals minus 2î plus 2ĵ plus 2k̂ - î minus 2ĵ plus k̂.
= minus 3î plus 3k̂.
So the answer is i (-î plus 4ĵ plus k̂)/3 ii minus 3î plus 3k̂.

homework.en: NCERT Exercise 10.2: section formula and direction cosines

narration.en: Recap. Vector from P to Q = position vector of Q − position vector of P. Direction cosines = components ÷ magnitude, and l² + m² + n² = 1. Section formula: internal (mb⃗ + na⃗)/(m + n); external (mb⃗ − na⃗)/(m − n).
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. P ಯಿಂದ Q ಗೆ ಸದಿಶ = Q ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶ − P ಸ್ಥಾನ ಸದಿಶ. ದಿಕ್ ಕೊಸೈನ್‌ಗಳು = ಘಟಕ ÷ ಪರಿಮಾಣ; l² + m² + n² = 1. ವಿಭಾಗ ಸೂತ್ರ: ಒಳಗೆ (mb + na)/(m + n); ಹೊರಗೆ (mb − na)/(m − n).
